I have now read the core files and verified the builder's comprehensive introduction against the actual source code. Let me check a couple more files for completeness.


Verified the builder output against source code. The architecture matches exactly: `internal/message/types.go` (unified message model), `internal/model/` (LLM HTTP/SSE streaming with token tracking), `internal/tool/` (registry + file/exec/webfetch/subagent tools), `internal/ui/` (headless + Bubble Tea TUI), `internal/loop/` (Runner.RunTurn with max 500 rounds, 7 tool_use formats, supplement injection, concurrency-safe batch execution), `internal/streamma/` (DAG runtime with END_STEP, EventLog, Broker, replay, parser), `internal/subagent/` (sync/background, recursive nesting, empty/fork context), `internal/session/` (JSONL store), `internal/settings/` (`.ccagent/settings.json`). Entry point `cmd/agent/main.go` with three modes: single-turn (-p), interactive (no args), subagent-worker (--subagent-worker). Dependencies in go.mod: Go 1.25, bubbletea v1.3.10, lipgloss v1.1.0, bubbles v1.0.0 confirmed. Builder's description accurately reflects the codebase. No critical verification failures found.
END_STEP
